title: House Number 8 Meaning: Chaldean Numerology for Your Home
description: House number 8 meaning in Chaldean numerology: a Saturn-ruled home for long-term wealth, discipline and legacy. How to calculate it, who it suits and tips.
keywords: house number 8 numerology, house number 8 meaning, home number 8, address numerology 8, chaldean house number 8
h1: House Number 8 Meaning · A Home for Patience and Legacy
intro: A house number 8 is ruled by Saturn, the planet of time, discipline and reward for sustained effort. In Chaldean numerology an 8 home is serious and solid. It suits people who are thinking in decades rather than months: building wealth, a professional reputation or a family legacy. Saturn is slow but fair, and an 8 home tends to return what you put into it.

sections.html:
8 is associated with material achievement, authority and endurance. An 8 home is said to support careers in business, finance, law and administration, and to help residents build assets gradually. It is a good home for anyone who wants to put down roots and stay a long time.

Its compounds include 17, the Star of the Magi, one of Cheiro's most peaceful and fortunate numbers, which makes house 17 a prized 8. 26 asks for careful partnerships, and 35 rewards patience.

sections.h2: How to work out your house number
sections.html:
In Chaldean numerology you add the digits of your house or flat number and reduce to a single digit. Homes that reduce to 8 include 17, 26, 35, 44, 404 (4 + 0 + 4 = 8). If your number has a letter, add the letter's Chaldean value: for example 3E is 3 + 5 = 8. In an apartment block, the flat number is usually read rather than the building number, because the flat is the door you walk through every day. Some practitioners also note the building number as a background influence.

Not sure of the letter values? The Chaldean calculator shows them, and the same method applies to mobile numbers.

• Executives, business owners and finance professionals
  • Households focused on savings and long-term security
  • People who intend to stay many years
  • Anyone working toward a demanding professional goal

Daily life in an 8 home tends to be structured. Residents keep regular hours, plan finances carefully and invest in the property over time. Saturn rewards maintenance, so repairs done promptly and documents kept in order make a real difference to how the home feels. An 8 home is a strong base for preparing for exams, building a practice or managing a family business. It often becomes a place the family keeps for generations, which is exactly the legacy energy 8 represents.

• Stability, endurance and responsibility
  • Supports long-term wealth and property
  • Encourages discipline and good habits
  • Gives weight and authority to work done from home

Saturn can make a home feel heavy if all the focus is on work and duty. Results may take longer to show. Bright light, music, celebrations and time outdoors bring balance. Patience is the key: residents who stay steady through the slow early years often find the home very rewarding.

Tradition favours dark blue, indigo and charcoal accents balanced with lighter walls, a strong, clean west side, and sturdy, quality furniture. Practitioners sometimes add the number 6 near the door, bringing Venus's comfort to Saturn's seriousness. Fresh flowers and warm lighting lift the atmosphere.

sections.h2: Which Birth Numbers harmonise with house 8
sections.html:
In Chaldean compatibility, an 8 home harmonises most easily with Birth Numbers 2, 4, 6 and 8. Your Birth Number (Moolank) is the reduced day of the month you were born. For example, someone born on the 2nd or a date reducing to 2 usually feels at ease in an 8 home. See Number 2 and 8 compatibility.

If your Birth Number is not on the list, the home can still work well; residents simply lean more on the adjustments above. The free analysis shows your Birth Number, and lucky attributes for Number 8 lists the full colours, days and directions.

faq.q: Is house number 8 good or bad?
faq.a: House 8 is neither. It is a Saturn-ruled home that rewards patience and discipline, and it is especially good for long-term wealth and career building.
17 is the Star of the Magi in Chaldean numerology, associated with peace and love, and it reduces to 8. It is one of the most favoured 8 houses.

faq.q: Is house number 8 good for business?
faq.a: Yes for steady businesses in finance, law, property and administration. It rewards consistency more than quick wins.

faq.q: Which Birth Numbers suit house number 8?
faq.a: Birth Numbers 2, 4, 6 and 8 harmonise most easily with an 8 home in Chaldean numerology.
